annihilator.constant_coefficient: on the unilateral domain d >= 6 the annihilator ideal is exactly (S^8): S^8 annihilates because padded B_d = 0 for d >= 14, S^7 fails at d = 6 because B_13 != 0, and backward induction shows every annihilator has lowest shift exponent >= 8; in particular no annihilator with nonzero constant term, and no reversible backward recurrence, exists
